title: MiniMed Completes Separation from Medtronic

body_markdown:
NORTHRIDGE, Calif.


, Oct. 15, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- MiniMed (Nasdaq: MMED) today announced the completion of its separation from Medtronic plc ("Medtronic"; NYSE: MDT), marking its first day as a fully independent company.


"Today marks the completion of our separation from Medtronic and a significant milestone for MiniMed," said Que Dallara, Chief Executive Officer of MiniMed. "We are grateful to Medtronic for its partnership and support in reaching this point. As an independent company, we have the freedom to make the decisions we believe are right for our business and the people we serve, and the responsibility to see those decisions through. Our focus now is to put that independence to work and continue advancing what is possible in diabetes care."


As separately announced yesterday, Medtronic accepted an aggregate of 55,032,401 Medtronic ordinary shares in exchange for 252,813,348 shares of MiniMed common stock. As a result, Medtronic no longer holds an equity stake in MiniMed. The exchange offer was 5.4x subscribed.


Full details of the results of the exchange offer are available in a separate press release issued yesterday by Medtronic. The exchange agent will promptly credit newly issued shares of MiniMed common stock in book-entry form to accounts maintained by the MiniMed transfer agent for tendering shareholders whose Medtronic ordinary shares were accepted in the exchange offer. Checks in lieu of fractional shares of MiniMed common stock will be delivered after the exchange agent has aggregated all fractional shares and sold them in the open market.


**About MiniMed** MiniMed is a global leader in insulin delivery, constantly advancing therapies that support people with diabetes in 80 countries. Our full-stack, integrated ecosystem, including our insulin delivery systems, CGMs, algorithms, and easy-to-use app experience, is designed to work seamlessly together, supported by white-glove, wrap-around service. For over 40 years, we've pioneered therapies people can rely on by anticipating needs, reducing burden, and helping make life with diabetes easier. Our mission is to make every day a better day for people with diabetes.
